# A window prop that reads itself folds once and stops.
#
# Folding `home.title` yields the window's `title` expression, which is folded
# again against the context the read sits in -- that is what lets a read inside
# an unrolled loop body see the loop variable. A prop that names its own window
# returns itself, so the second fold re-enters on the same prop and the third
# on the same one again: unguarded this is a stack overflow, not a diagnostic.
#
# Left standing is what a prop with no answer already reached codegen as, so
# the guard changes nothing else. A CLI test rather than a golden because what
# is asserted is that the compiler comes back at all.
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out selfref.sngl
# The page has content: `exists` alone would pass on a file merely touched.
grep '<span>hi</span>' out/index.html
# And no <title>, which is what "left standing" costs. A select the fold could
# not answer reaches codegen as a dangling reference and html writes nothing
# for it -- silent missing output, not a crash. Pinned because it is a
# deliberate choice and the alternative (a positioned error) is a language rule
# this MR does not make. `const a int = a` is the same shape one layer down and
# crashed the compiler outright until the guard beside this one
# (const_reads_itself.txt), so self-reference is something the compiler neither
# refuses nor survived -- and this is the only one of the two that terminated.
! grep '<title>' out/index.html

# Two windows naming each other reach the guard by a second key rather than by
# the first one twice, which is the path a single self-reference never takes.
# They have to sit in a root component's body: at the root of a file the
# windows are registered in order, so the first cannot name the second at all.
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out2 mutual.sngl
grep '<span>a</span>' out2/a.html
grep '<span>b</span>' out2/b.html
! grep '<title>' out2/a.html
! grep '<title>' out2/b.html

-- selfref.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}

window #home(title=home.title, href="/index.html") {
    text(value="hi")
}
-- mutual.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}

component pages root {
    window #a(title=b.title, href="/a.html") {
        text(value="a")
    }
    window #b(title=a.title, href="/b.html") {
        text(value="b")
    }
}

pages()
